title: Johnson Controls energy savings contract Phase 3
summary: The administration said Phase 1 cost about $25 million with net savings of $11.9 million, and Phase 3 would cost $9,021,259 plus about 4.49 percent interest through a lease purchase. After a deferral and committee approval, the council voted 9–0 in July to finance Phase 3.

timeline.text: Members voted 9–0 to finance Phase 3 of an energy savings contract, up to $9,021,259 plus interest.
